claim.statement: Cursor's rolling modes documentation distinguishes Agent for autonomous exploration, multi-file edits and commands; Ask for read-only exploration; Manual for selected-file editing; and configurable Custom modes.

source.title: Cursor Agent modes
source.locator: Modes table and Agent, Ask, Manual and Custom sections

limitations: The page is rolling documentation and is not tied to the exact 3.16 binary or one account's feature flags.
The modes are mutually scoped alternatives; capabilities from Agent must not be attributed to Ask or Manual.
unknowns: The selected mode and effective custom-mode tool configuration are unknown.
Whether the documented mode set was identical for every 3.16 account and platform is unknown.
